messages:
oncall-bot: PagerDuty P2 triggered — multiple private deployments in europe-west9 reporting packet loss / BGP withdraws via customer interconnect. Auto-alert: 30% request failures to private endpoints, intermittent.

raj_infra: seeing the same in metrics — spike in tcp retransmits and 502s to private routes. affected customers: cust-zen, cust-orbit, and a couple of smaller on-prem setups.

tariq_net: started a traceroute to one of the impacted on-prem IPs. see 100% loss past 10.64.0.1 (peer edge) then intermittent replies from 169.254.x.x.

elaine_ops: tagging customer success (julie_cs) — julie, are we getting direct customer reports or just telemetry?

julie_cs: two customers opened support tickets ~3m ago, reported latency spikes and timeouts. they reported traffic flows through partner interconnect. asking for an ETA.

raj_infra: quick checks:
```
# Verifying Cloud Router status
gcloud compute routers get-status router-eu-west9 --region europe-west9
# BGP peer summary
gcloud compute routers describe router-eu-west9 --region europe-west9 --format=\"yaml\" | egrep -i 'bgp|peer'
```
Outputs show repeated BGP NOT_ADVERTISED events and peer flaps on peer-id 101.

matt_sre: confirmed syslog from peer: repeated UPDATE/CEASE from provider side, metric shows hold timer flapping.

tariq_net: started failover plan: we can shift affected private routes to the secondary partner interconnect (if sessions exist) and advertise more-specifics from europe-west1 as temporary fallback. will need to coordinate with infra and update route-priority.

raj_infra: steps I'm executing now:
- escalate to GCP TAC (opened case 0123456789)
- gather RTX captures and cloud-router logs
- prepare temporary route injection from europe-west1
- notify customers of mitigation window

gcp-support-bot: Case 0123456789 created. Assigned to EngOps L3. ETA initial response 15m.

elaine_ops: matt, can you draft the customer-facing blurb? Keep it short, mention mitigation steps and timeline.

matt_sre: draft: \"We're investigating intermittent connectivity from europe-west9 to on-prem via partner interconnect. We're routing traffic to a secondary egress and engaging cloud provider. Expect degraded behavior for up to 45 minutes while we validate failover.\" ping if changes.

julie_cs: sending that to custodial customers now and creating an incident advisory with status updates every 15m.

tariq_net: executing route swap: pushing more-specific /24s from europe-west1 to prefer secondary egress. Command run: 
```
gcloud compute routes create tmp-egress-pref-<cust> --network redwood-vpc --next-hop-vpn-gateway <gw> --priority 100
```
I'll monitor traffic shift.

raj_infra: confirming metric change — outbound flows to cust-zen show 60% drop on europe-west9 path and increase on europe-west1. Latency dropping but still some packet loss.

matt_sre: rolling canary on failover for cust-zen looks healthy (50% traffic) — errors down to baseline.

elaine_ops: timeline note: 00:00 trigger, 00:04 TAC case opened, 00:08 route injection started, 00:18 partial recovery for first customer.

gcp-support-bot: TAC update: provider edge experiencing hardware-restart behaviour, performing maintenance on affected POP. Estimated time to resolution subject to hardware swap. Recommend continuing temporary reroutes.

tariq_net: continuing with expanded more-specific announcements for other impacted tenants. will keep a /24-by-/24 approach to minimize collateral.

raj_infra: capturing post-failover logs and checking for session sticky behavior. please add any pod-level retries we should know about.

matt_sre: note — Redis-heavy customers may see transient errors as sessions fail over. Recommend increasing retry backoff on transient 502/504s for next 1h.

julie_cs: CS updated customers with mitigation steps and ETA from GCP (hardware swap). customers acknowledged and asked for confirmation when stable.

elaine_ops: preparing handoff for the night shift. who will own the post-mitigation verification and long-term RCA?

raj_infra: I can own RCA with Tariq for network root cause. Matt — can you own durable monitoring alerts to detect regressions and add a synthetic for private endpoint health?

matt_sre: will add synthetic probe (every 1m) from europe-west9 and europe-west1 to private endpoints and a dashboard tile. will also add alert if error rate > 5% for 10m.

tariq_net: GCP updated case: hardware swap completed on provider POP, they see stable BGP session. we'll keep reroutes in place for 30m and then gradually withdraw to validate.

raj_infra: withdrawing temporary /24s for cust-zen now, monitoring.

matt_sre: metrics show a clean transition back to europe-west9, errors stable at baseline.

julie_cs: customers report normal behavior. closing interim advisory but will keep them informed about RCA timeline.

elaine_ops: incident summary to ship after RCA: short outage window impacting private interconnect in europe-west9 caused by provider edge hardware instability; mitigation: temporary reroutes to secondary egress and coordination with GCP TAC; customers restored.

raj_infra: logging RCA kickoff notes into the incident tracker: link to playbook, logs, and TAC case.

matt_sre: leaving a follow-up action: add partner interconnect health probe to our console and add automated fallback to secondary interconnect for customers with dual interconnect.

oncall-bot: Incident P2 (1768504321) resolved and moved to monitoring. Please ack if you are taking any followup tasks.

raj_infra: ack — I'll own the RCA doc and postmortem.

tariq_net: ack — will follow up with partner for confirmation of hardware replacement details.

elaine_ops: thanks team. will prepare postmortem draft and customer exec summary.
